Class AbstractMessagePort

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.interop.AbstractMessagePort
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, MessagePort
Direct Known Subclasses:
AtLeastOncePort, ExactlyOncePort, FireAndForgetPort, InMemoryMessagePort
public abstract class AbstractMessagePort extends Object implements MessagePort
Base implementation of MessagePort with common bookkeeping.

Handles EBCDIC translation, Record-to-bytes conversion, and listener thread management. Subclasses implement the transport-specific operations:

  • doSend(byte[], Map) — put bytes on the wire
  • doReceive(long) — get bytes from the wire
  • doOpen() / doClose() — connection lifecycle
